decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the smaller, thinner whisk geometry required for fine powder and 2.5-quart bowls.
The source treats the 2.5-quart bowl capacity as an existing selection and changes the whisk selection; it does not otherwise change bowl size or geometry.
Selecting a smaller whisk does not change the current requirement to deliver the prototype system layout in CAD.
The mechanical whisk-size correction does not change the requirement to provide a basic electrical wiring plan.
Changing whisk size does not alter the required quick-removal and bowl-swapping behavior.
The source changes the required whisk dimensions but does not change or waive the strategy of using simple off-the-shelf prototype electronics.
Whisk dimensions have no stated effect on the beige body and green accent color requirements.
The source does not change the enclosure thickness, deep-well accommodation, or overall size constraint.
The whisk-selection correction does not affect the required machine placard text.
The source specifies an appropriately sized whisk but does not change the existing splash-control target.
Message 43 changes only the whisk selection; it does not alter the spout's location, orientation, geometry, or pouring access.
The smaller-whisk decision does not change the requirement that the unit remain stable without rattling or shifting.
